parts.label: b
parts.text:
She places two pins P1 and P2 on line EF, as shown in Fig. 4.1, and replaces the block.
She observes the images of P1 and P2 through side CD of the block so that the images
of P1 and P2 appear one behind the other. She places two pins P3 and P4 between her
eye and the block so that P3, P4 and the images of P1 and P2, seen through the block,
appear one behind the other.
